why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open The infiniFi Chapter campaign page Start from the campaign page , which lists the three missions and their bonus APY. The same campaign is linked from the banner on the Jumper homepage .
2 Step 2 : Choose a lock length Pick the 4-week , 8-week or 13-week mission. A longer lock lists a higher bonus APY, up to 10%, 15% and 20% respectively.
3 Step 3 : Connect a wallet Connect a wallet in the Jumper app.

4 Step 4 : Complete the mission Each mission is one of infiniFi's 4-, 8- or 13-week lock opportunities on Jumper Earn, so taking part means locking funds for the period you chose. The mission cards show Ethereum, and the pages do not name the deposit asset. Jumper XP is earned across the missions.
5 Step 5 : Watch for the INFI claim The campaign page says INFI rewards will be claimable after the infiniFi TGE in Q4 2026.
